name: My Komainu
source:
A visual novel about a kid and his cute spiritual companion who helps him learn some lessons on responsibility and selflessness.  

[From [url=https://daebak.itch.io/my-komainu]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部關於孩子和可愛狛犬靈伴的視覺小說。它將幫助孩子學會負責，也學會為別人著想。

[來源：[url=https://daebak.itch.io/my-komainu]Itch.io[/url]]
